source.quote_free_summary: Formation teams may have four to eight couples per style, and the next sentence defines a couple with sex-specific wording.

requirement: A future NDCA profile must enforce team size 4 to 8 couples per formation style. The couple make-up wording conflicts with NDCA II.A.7.a, so it must not be implemented until the conflict is resolved by the owner.
enforcement_point: NOT IMPLEMENTED. Future: NDCA entry format with a size rule. The generic Studio/Custom team model (2 to 100 members, no body rules) must not carry it (OD-28 item 9); it belongs to a future body profile.
interpretation_notes: NDCA: no explicit effective date is printed in the supplied PDF (cover: June 2026 edition); effective_from 2026-06-01 is the first day of the edition month and must be confirmed. Re-read 2026-11-23 (XII.D; the couple wording is the phrase 'one boy and one girl'). Audit conflict CL-11: NDCA II.A.7.a defines a couple as a leader and follower 'without regard to the sex or gender of the dancer'. No reconciliation is invented here and no gender or sex data is collected or required. Studio/Custom keeps 2 to 100 members. BLOCKER for an NDCA profile.
